en: Black-and-white photograph showing a formal garden pond or small lake with numerous ducks swimming. Dense, lush vegetation including tall coniferous trees and palms surrounds the water. In the background, partly hidden by foliage, stands a small round classical pavilion or temple-like structure with columns. In the foreground on the right, a small ornamental stone pedestal or planter rises from the water.
